title: Autonomous Runner Smoke
goal: Create one small docs/testing-only smoke evidence file without touching product runtime or roadmap status.
acceptance: The smoke evidence file contains the exact phrase MyOwnWorld autonomous runner smoke PASS.
No product runtime, roadmap or persistent-format file is modified.

commands.command: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const p='docs/03-testing/agent-tasks/smoke-output/first-autonomous-smoke.txt';if(!fs.existsSync(p))process.exit(1);const text=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');if(!text.includes('MyOwnWorld autonomous runner smoke PASS'))process.exit(1);"
commands.reason: The smoke task is complete only when the dedicated evidence file exists with the approved marker.
The smoke output must not introduce whitespace errors.

risk.notes: The task is constrained to a single testing evidence file and must not modify product runtime or roadmap status.

notes: This task is intended only for the first live autonomous runner smoke.
The runner must not commit, merge or push the task branch.
